'''Amber''' is a gem found by [[Archaeology|brushing]] suspicious blocks in trail ruins. It is used to buy [[Amber Earrings]] from the [[Jeweler]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Archaeology ===
Amber is one of the rare finds in trail ruins suspicious gravel.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/archaeology/trail_ruins_rare.json}}</ref>
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
=== Trading ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Villager !! Level !! Wants !! Gives
|-
| [[Jeweler]] || Journeyman || 8 × {{ItemLink|Obol}} + {{ItemLink|Amber}} || {{ItemLink|Amber Earrings}}
|-
| [[Jeweler]] || Master || {{ItemLink|Amber}} || 4 × {{ItemLink|Obol}}
|}
<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/5/sell_amber.json}}</ref>
Amber can either be turned into [[jewelry]] or sold back to a Master-level Jeweler for 4 [[Obol]]s.

== Advancements ==
Obtaining amber grants ''Canto III'' ("Exhume the Pilgrim's Trails") in the [[Advancements/Tutorial|Tutorial]] tab, which rewards a [[Crystal Heart]]. It follows ''Canto II''.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/obtain_amber.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Gems can now be sold to the Jeweler.}}
{{History line|1.12.3|Now built on a poisonous potato instead of a fermented spider eye, so it no longer counts as a fermented spider eye in recipes.}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* Like the other gems, amber is built on a poisonous potato; through 1.12.2 it was built on a fermented spider eye.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/item_modifier/amber.json}}</ref>
